about: Category Grid: a letter and five categories. Teams write one word for each category that starts with the letter. Reveal shows example answers. Built from word lists per level; at least 50 rounds per level, shuffled every game.

intro.title: Category Grid
text: You get a letter and five categories.
Write one word for each category.

intro.title: Start with the letter
text: Every word must start with the letter.

intro.title: Win points
text: A word no other team has: +2!

before.name: Long words
before.text: Words with 7 letters or more count double!

secret.name: Fastest team
secret.text: +2 for the team that finished first!

secret.name: Rare word
secret.text: +2 for the most unusual correct word!

secret.name: Use it!
secret.text: +1 for a sentence with one of your words!
